mission_05: The Box-Cox transformation is a family of power transformations that automatically finds the optimal lambda parameter to make data as normal as possible. Unlike the fixed log transform, Box-Cox searches through different power transformations (including log, square root, and reciprocal) to find the best one. This makes it more flexible and often more effective at normalizing data. In this mission, you will apply scipy.stats.boxcox() to multiple columns, capture the optimal lambda values, and compare the resulting skewness. Note that Box-Cox requires strictly positive data.
